mapper.select: SELECT time, requests, errors, q[1] AS p50, q[2] AS p90, q[3] AS p99 FROM ( SELECT toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfInterval(time_bucket, toIntervalSecond(#{stepSec})))) * 1000 AS time, toFloat64(sumMerge(request_count)) AS requests, toFloat64(sumMerge(error_count)) AS errors, quantilesMerge(0.5, 0.9, 0.99)(duration_quantiles) AS q FROM quasar_tracing.service_endpoint_summary WHERE span_kind = 'Server' AND time_bucket BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to}) GROUP BY time ) ORDER BY time

SELECT toUInt32(uniqExact(TraceId)) AS total, toUInt32(uniqExactIf(TraceId, StatusCode = 'Error')) AS errors FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{from}) AND fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(#{to})
